toegepas.voor: Aan die ander kant moes 'n ander mens
toegepas.na: Aan die ander punt van die lyn moes iemand anders
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Aan die ander kant' reads as the idiom 'on the other hand', and 'ander kant ... ander mens' repeats 'ander'.
toegepas.fout: 'Aan die ander kant' reads first as the idiom 'on the other hand', and 'ander' is repeated.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal removes the false idiom reading and the repetition without changing who does what.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Terselfdertyd' is the natural Afrikaans form of 'at the same time'.
toegepas.fout: 'op dieselfde tyd' copies English 'at the same time'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Terselfdertyd' is the natural Afrikaans form and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hier' is vague mid-sentence; 'So' links the conclusion to the comparison before it.
toegepas.fout: 'hier' is vague in mid-sentence and does not clearly link the conclusion to the comparison.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'So' ties the conclusion to the preceding sentences more naturally with no change in meaning.

toegepas.voor: het dowe mense geleer en hy wou
toegepas.na: het dowe mense onderrig, en hy wou
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Geleer' can read as 'learned from'; 'onderrig' is unambiguous, and the AWS comma joins two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: 'dowe mense geleer' without an object can stumble between teach and learn, and the AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Onderrig' is unambiguous and the comma is required by the AWS for two clauses with their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: laat 'n dun vel vibreer wat ons 'n membraan noem
toegepas.na: laat 'n dun vel vibreer. Ons noem daardie vel 'n membraan
toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative clause 'wat ons ... noem' is separated from 'vel' by the verb and seems to refer to the vibrating; two short sentences are clearer for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause 'wat ons 'n membraan noem' is separated from 'vel' by the verb and can seem to refer to the vibrating.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two short sentences are clearer for Grade 4 and the protected word membraan stays intact.

toegepas.voor: weer klank en die ander mens hoor
toegepas.na: weer klank, en die ander mens hoor
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation fix only, required by the AWS 2017.

toegepas.voor: in plaas van op 'n brief te wag
toegepas.na: in plaas daarvan om op 'n brief te wag
toegepas.rede_vinder: Before an infinitive clause the standard form is 'in plaas daarvan om ... te'.
toegepas.fout: 'in plaas van ... te wag' lacks the 'om' construction standard Afrikaans needs before an infinitive clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Grammar fix with no change in meaning, within the list-item allowance.

toegepas.voor: in plaas van dit later te lees
toegepas.na: in plaas daarvan om dit later te lees
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same construction as the first list item: 'in plaas daarvan om ... te'.
toegepas.fout: 'in plaas van dit later te lees' lacks the 'om' construction before an infinitive clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same grammar fix as item 8, keeping the list consistent.

toegepas.na: Families wat ver van mekaar gewoon het, kon
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Families ver van mekaar' is a clipped English-style phrase; a relative clause makes it natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'Families ver van mekaar kon' is a clipped English-style phrase.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause is what a fluent writer would use, and living apart is what the original already implies.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The comparison clause lacks its verb, so the closing 'nie' hangs; 'kan' completes it.
toegepas.fout: The comparison 'soos ons vandag nie' lacks its verb, so the closing 'nie' hangs and the reader stumbles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'kan' completes the comparison and keeps the negation intact.

toegepas.voor: Toe is telefoonpale opgerig en lang lyne is tussen dorpe gespan
toegepas.na: Toe is telefoonpale opgerig en lang lyne tussen dorpe gespan
toegepas.rede_vinder: The repeated 'is' is wooden; the two passives can share one auxiliary, which also needs no comma.
toegepas.fout: The repeated 'is' is wooden, and as written the two clauses would also need an AWS comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Sharing one auxiliary reads naturally and leaves the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: het drukknoppies in die plek van die draaiknop gekom
toegepas.na: het drukknoppies die plek van die draaiknop ingeneem
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die plek van iets inneem' is the natural idiom for replacing something.
toegepas.fout: 'in die plek van ... gekom' is a loose calque of 'came in place of'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die plek ingeneem' is the fixed Afrikaans idiom for replacing something, with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: Toe kom die selfoon en die draad
toegepas.na: Toe het die selfoon gekom, en die draad
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two clauses with their own subject and verb need the AWS comma, and the tense now matches 'het weggeval'.
toegepas.fout: The sentence mixes present 'kom' with past 'het weggeval' and lacks the AWS comma between two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal makes the tense consistent within the sentence and adds the required comma without moving the meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'n Manier kry' is a calque of 'get a way'; Afrikaans finds ('vind') a way.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n Manier kry' is natural spoken Afrikaans, so 'vind' is a lateral swap.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Een eie draad' is awkward; 'n eie draad' is the idiomatic way to say a wire of their own.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'een' is a number that may have been deliberately checked, and swapping it for 'n' touches that count.

laat_vaar.voor: kon 'n mens self 'n nommer kies met 'n draaiknop op die telefoon
laat_vaar.na: kon 'n mens self met 'n draaiknop op die telefoon 'n nommer kies
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the infinitive goes at the end; the prepositional phrase belongs before 'n nommer kies'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after the verb is normal Afrikaans, so the reorder is lateral.

vlae.teks: Die telefoon dra jou stem self oor die draad na die ander mens.
vlae.rede: This may read as the wire carrying the voice itself, while the block 'Hoe 'n telefoon jou stem oordra' says the wire carries signals, not sound; not changed because fixing it means choosing content.
